headline: System Memory vs Context Memory — Today's Micro-Learning
summary: 3 layers of memory: persistent (auto-inject) + Obsidian (permanent) + SQLite (searchable). Use each for its strength.

micro_learning.insight: Three layers of memory: (1) Persistent memory — critical facts auto-injected every session. (2) Obsidian — unlimited permanent knowledge. (3) SQLite logs — searchable archive of every conversation. Use each for its strength.
micro_learning.action: Don't fight memory — build the system so Hermes remembers for you.
micro_learning.why: You spent 4 hours today rebuilding context from scratch. With proper memory layers, that drops to minutes. Every session you don't repeat yourself is compounding alpha.
